basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior AI Architect · Production LLM & Agent Systems · Tech Lead · MBA
basics.summary: Senior AI architect who designs, ships, and operates production LLM and agent systems, then turns them into the paved-road patterns the rest of the org builds on. At LumApps, owns the agent platform end-to-end (Python, FastAPI, LangChain, GCP, RAG, evals, verification loops): 2x conversions, $4M forecast in approved opportunities per quarter. At Beekeeper, 6 years as Tech Lead through the Series B to F scale: architected systems serving 10M+ users, replaced a $337K vendor with a 6-week LLM pipeline, built the AI engineering cohort that raised standards across teams. Co-founded SwissNRI on the side, compliance-first cross-border fintech with regulatory guardrails built before features; Zurich-based, judgement over jargon.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns the enterprise AI agent platform end-to-end: architecture, runtime, integrations, evals, governance, rollout. Hands-on architect, not slideware.
highlights: Architected and shipped the production AI agent platform for outbound sales (Python, FastAPI, LangChain, GCP, RAG). Verification loops, evals, observability, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints built in from day one.
Outcomes the GTM org measures by: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter.
Owns company-wide AI governance: where agents can act, where humans verify, how outcomes get measured. Reports to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Tech lead through the Series B to F scale. Architected production systems serving 10M+ users while building the engineering practice around them. Deputy tech lead of FUEL; acting hiring manager for AI roles.
highlights: Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Hired for craft and curiosity, defined the pro-code standards for agent development that scaled beyond any individual. Same shape as an AI Developer Guild.

Designed distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90%. Now powers 15% of all assets created on the platform for 10M+ users. The paved-road pattern: customers stopped re-solving the same problem.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; production GenAI in a sensitive enterprise environment.

Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead reporting to CIO. Top revenue channel on the platform: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA, distributed services on Kafka + PostgreSQL.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology evaluation panelist for a Swiss fintech accelerator. Architecture and AI-readiness reviews for seed-to-VC stage startups.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL Spin-off)
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built the architecture, infrastructure, and algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) with real-time flight control APIs. 500+ deliveries powering a Unilever partnership and a CES Las Vegas showcase. 40% faster, 99.5% safety, zero incidents.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that earned customer trust from the first deployment.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I approach modern LLM and agentic systems today.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech Platform
projects.description: Compliance-first cross-border fintech for Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulations. Regulatory guardrails built into the architecture before features.
highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Compliance-first design with regulatory guardrails for both jurisdictions built before features.
Customer feedback loops drove 40% uplift in satisfaction. Roadmap owned by what users actually asked for.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data. Core principle: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. Verification before output, every time.
highlights: Built the full stack solo: agent runtime, real-time market data integrations, signal generation and justification layer, web frontend.
Live retail users. Explainability and auditability as the product, not a feature.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate Operations
projects.description: Property inspections ran on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Redesigned the workflow before automating it: built MVP for a fully digital, image-backed, timestamped inspection process.
highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based inspection workflows with structured, image-backed, timestamped records.
Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates property listings from inspection data.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Vontobel Senior AI Architect (80-100%), Zurich. Define, own, and continuously evolve the enterprise AI architecture; lead hands-on delivery of production-grade AI solutions end-to-end. Design and build LLM- and agent-based systems; establish best practices for LLM and RAG architectures; architect scalable, secure, resilient AI platforms with distributed and event-driven patterns. Hands-on architecture leader (not purely strategic), mentor senior engineers, lead architecture and design reviews, deliver production-ready prototypes and reference implementations. Work with Product, Security, Risk, Legal/Compliance, IT to meet regulatory, governance, and model-risk requirements. Lead the AI Developer Guild to raise engineering standards across the org. 8+ years engineering, several in architecture/tech leadership delivering production AI/LLM solutions. Strong Python + modern API/service development. Practical LLM-powered applications (LLMs, RAG, agent-based patterns). MLOps and AI platform engineering (model/prompt lifecycle, offline/online eval, drift detection, reproducibility, auditability). DevOps + cloud (CI/CD, IaC, Kubernetes/OpenShift, observability, secure cloud-native, preferably Azure). Regulated enterprise comfort. Pragmatic, communicative leader and mentor; English fluent, German strong plus.
_jobApplication.notes: Architecture leadership angle: led with Beekeeper AI cohort (= AI Developer Guild analogue), templating engine (= paved-road reference pattern), LLM pipeline (= production GenAI in enterprise). Surfaced verification loops and Langfuse-based evals as MLOps signal. SwissNRI moved to first project to lead with regulated/compliance experience. Note: Azure not in stack (have AWS + GCP); MS Certified Professional + Vontobel's 'we recruit for learning, not certifications' covers the gap.
